answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with proof-of-relay: each identity must forward unique encrypted chunks for random peers, like a harbor pilot guiding every voyage through its own channel. Throughput and timing are measured, so clones sharing one pipe throttle each other and form a detectable bottleneck, while a farm buying separate bandwidth for thousands of fakes pays per identity. One honest agent relays a small garden of packets cheaply and earns standing from real service.
